info.name: TMaps API
info.description:
Maps, geocoding and routing APIs with worldwide coverage and extra detail for Tunisia.

## Get started
1. Create an API key in the [TMaps console](https://app.tmaps.tn).
2. Import the **TMaps** environment, set `api_key` and select the environment.
3. Run **Geocoding → Forward geocoding**: it saves the result's coordinates for the other requests.

## Authentication
Every request sends the key in the `api_key` query parameter. It is set once on the collection (Authorization tab) and inherited by all requests. TMaps does not use an `Authorization` header.

Postman calls the API from a server context (no `Origin` header), so the key's authorized domains don't apply here. For backend use, create a dedicated key with no authorized domain: it works from your servers and is rejected in browsers if it ever leaks.

## Conventions
- JSON responses, UTF-8. Coordinates in WGS84 decimal degrees (`lat`, `lng`). Distances in meters, durations in seconds.
- Errors return `{"error": "..."}` with standard HTTP codes: 400 bad parameter, 401 missing or revoked key, 403 domain not authorized, 404 not found, 429 burst protection, 5xx server error.

## Links
- Documentation: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation
- Live examples: https://examples.tmaps.tn/
- Source: https://github.com/tmaps-tn/tmaps-snippets

request.description:
Turns a free-text address into GPS coordinates, with a confidence score and the Tunisian administrative breakdown (commune, delegation, governorate).

Each result gives the point in `geometry.location` (`lat`, `lng`), a `formatted` address, a `confidence` between 0 and 1 and `components`.

The test script saves the first result's coordinates in the `lat` and `lng` collection variables, so you can run **Reverse geocoding** and **Nearby search** right after.

Docs: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation/api/geocoding/forward · Live example: https://examples.tmaps.tn/04-geocoding-search/

request.description:
Turns GPS coordinates into a Plus Code (Open Location Code), a short address such as `8F8GR54J+JJ` that works in Google Maps and any app that supports Plus Codes.

`zoom` sets the length of the code. `zoom=18` gives 10 digits, a cell of about 14 m, the usual precision to show. Without `zoom` the code has 14 characters.

Uses the `lat` / `lng` collection variables (Tunis center by default, or the last **Forward geocoding** result).

Live example: https://examples.tmaps.tn/13-plus-code/

request.description:
Returns the Plus Code of the center of a map tile, for example to label the tile under the cursor or the current view. The code always has 10 digits (about 14 m); `lat` / `lng` are the coordinates of the tile center.

Tiles use the same XYZ scheme as the **Raster tile (PNG)** request: `zoom=14&x=8655&y=6389` is a tile over Tunis.

Send either `lat` and `lng`, or `zoom`, `x` and `y`: with neither, the API answers `400`.

item.name: Routing
item.description:
Routes, travel-time matrices, isochrones and optimized tours in Tunisia.

Shared parameters: `profile` (driving, walking, cycling, truck, scooter), `language` (fr, ar, en: instructions and street names), `departure_time` or `arrival_time` (local time, e.g. 2026-12-01T08:30), `avoid` (tolls, highways, ferries, unpaved; hard exclusion), `geometry` (polyline, polyline6, geojson). Distances in metres, durations in seconds. Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}` with INVALID_REQUEST, NO_ROUTE, OUT_OF_COVERAGE, LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

item.name: Static maps
item.description: Map images (PNG, WebP or JPEG) of a place, a route or an area, with markers, paths and polygons, built from a plain URL or a JSON body. Put the URL in an `` tag, an email template or a PDF. Shared parameters: `size` (required, WxH up to 1280 × 1280), `scale` (1 or 2), `style` (streets, dark, terrain, sunny, classic), `lang` (fr, ar), `format` (png, webp, jpg). Framing: `center` + `zoom` (1 to 20), `bbox`, or nothing to fit the overlays with `padding` (40 px by default). Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}` with INVALID_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, ENGINE_TIMEOUT, ENGINE_ERROR. **Not live yet:** `/maps/static` is implemented but not deployed in production. These requests fail (404) until it is.

request.description:
Route thumbnail: two markers and a path, auto-framed (no `center`, no `zoom`).

The `geometry` returned by `GET /routing/direction` (default `geometry=polyline`, precision 5) goes straight after `enc:`, URL-encoded: an encoded polyline can contain `|`, `\`, `{` or `}`. The value here is a short placeholder polyline so the request runs as is.

Paths also accept points: `path=color:red|36.80,10.17|36.85,10.33`. Polygons: `polygon=fillcolor:0x2e47f033|color:0x2e47f0|weight:2|lat,lng|lat,lng|lat,lng`.

**Not live yet:** `/maps/static` is implemented but not deployed in production. These requests fail (404) until it is.

request.description:
Same options as the GET request, as a JSON body (256 KB max): use it for long routes or many overlays that would make the URL too long. Returns the image.

`size` is `{"width", "height"}` or `"WxH"`, `center` is `{"lat", "lng"}`. Each item of `paths` and `polygons` takes one of `polyline` (encoded, precision 5), `coordinates` (`[lat, lng]` pairs or `{lat, lng}`) or `geojson` (LineString / Polygon, coordinates in `[lng, lat]` order), plus `color`, `weight` and, for polygons, `fillcolor`. 10,000 points at most over all overlays.

request.description:
Error example: `size` is missing. Errors are JSON with a status other than 200: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.

| Status | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | INVALID_REQUEST | Missing or invalid parameter |
| 401 | MISSING_API_KEY / INVALID_API_KEY | No key or unknown key |
| 404 | NOT_FOUND | Unknown style |
| 413 | LIMIT_EXCEEDED | Image larger than 1280 px, too many overlays or points |
| 504 | ENGINE_TIMEOUT | The map took too long to render |
| 500 | ENGINE_ERROR | The map could not be rendered |

When you load the image from code, check the status before using the body as an image.

**Not live yet:** `/maps/static` is implemented but not deployed in production. These requests fail (404) until it is.
